notes: DRAFT for R-STANCE-g. Short UI lines for ages 6+ about Beginner's Stance, a locked Open Leg Stance, and the new-player welcome. Each slot has one main pick and alternates for Jay/Manager to choose. No 'perfect', no guilt or pressure; real dojo training is what unlocks stances. Replaces placeholder 'Just standing. Learn a stance at the dojo!'

lines.use: One-liner shown for Beginner's Stance (plain standing, no bonus).
lines.main: Everyone starts here. Your first stance is waiting at the dojo!
alternates: Just you, standing tall. Your teacher can show you a stance!
This is where every student begins. Stances come from the dojo.

lines.use: Shown when Open Leg Stance is locked.
lines.main: Not yet! Learn Open Leg Stance at the dojo, and your teacher will sign it off.
alternates: Coming soon! Practice Open Leg Stance with your teacher to unlock it.
Learn this one at the dojo. When your teacher signs it off, it's yours!

lines.use: New-player welcome about starting in Beginner's Stance.
lines.main: Welcome! You start in Beginner's Stance, just like everyone. Learn stances at the dojo to grow stronger!
alternates: Welcome to the climb! Every student starts in Beginner's Stance.
Hello, new student! You begin in Beginner's Stance. Your teacher will help you learn more.
